prose.improvement_guidance: The false judgement to correct is the framing of the architecture finding itself as something within your control — it is not; it is a structural fact about your two customer classes that precedes your memo. The corrected judgement is that only your act of documenting, framing, and communicating that finding lies within your prohairesis; the finding is outside it. When you next draft a findings document under time pressure, begin by listing what is given and what is chosen; that single step anchors the control-filter discipline before the writing starts.
